title: Member Terms for Discounted Early Retirement of Capital Credits (Patronage Capital)
content:
# Discounted Early Retirement — Member Terms

**Capital Credits (Patronage Capital).** Where the patron class offers discounted early retirement — the Residential, Seasonal and Farm Patron Classes — a former member whose capital account is inactive may ask for all of the account's unretired credits to be retired early at a discount.

## Terms in force

1. **Time inactive.** A discounted early retirement may be requested only after the class's minimum inactive period — 12 full calendar months in each class that offers it — has passed since the capital account became inactive. Calendar months are counted from the date the account became inactive (the inactive date on the capital account) to the same day number of the later month, falling back to the last day of that month when the day number does not exist. A request made on the day the 12th month is completed qualifies.
2. **Window and minimum.** Requests are accepted only from September 1 through October 31 of a year, and only when the account's unretired credits are at least $100.00.
3. **Approval.** Requests are approved with that year's general retirement resolution and retired as special retirement entries of the discounted early type.
4. **Dissolved organizations.** In no class is a dissolved business or organization retired early; its credits stay in the general rotation.

## Retired terms

The following two terms are **no longer in force**; they have been superseded by the current basis:

- *Retired:* "The request covers the whole account; a partial early retirement is never made." — no longer in force.
- *Retired:* "Each row's payable is discounted exactly as an estate row is, but at the class's early retirement discount rate." — no longer in force.

The class's early retirement discount rate itself remains the figure of each class.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, Seasonal Patron Class)

| Inactive date | 12 full calendar months completed on | Request date | Time condition met |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2025-10-15 | 2026-10-15 | 2026-10-15 | Yes — on the boundary day |
| 2025-10-15 | 2026-10-15 | 2026-10-14 | No — one day short |
| 2024-02-29 | 2025-02-28 | 2025-02-28 | Yes (February 2025 has no 29th) |

A request that meets the time condition is still accepted only inside the September 1 – October 31 window and only with at least $100.00 unretired; in the first row, a request on 2026-10-15 for an account holding $100.00 or more meets the time, window and minimum conditions.

## Condition table

| Former member's account inactive 12 full months | Request inside the window | Unretired credits at least $100.00 | Class offers it | Dissolved organization | Request accepted |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes |
| No | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Yes | No | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Yes | Yes | No | Yes | No | No |
| Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
